summary.headline: Judgments on Brothers
summary.text: Astrological judgments about brothers and the native’s status, using the Moon’s separation and application, the lunar nodes in the house of brothers, the lord of the third sign, benefics and malefics, and triplicity lords of the ascendant and third house.
